errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

viewer.noPreview: No preview for this file. Share it to open it in another app.

_context.time.now: Very short, shown next to a row of a list: the item changed less than a minute ago.
_context.time.minutesAgo: As short as possible: minutes since the last activity, next to a row.
_context.time.hoursAgo: As short as possible: hours since the last activity, next to a row.
_context.time.daysAgo: As short as possible: days since the last activity, next to a row.
_context.errors.requestFailed: Shown when the server answered an error without a message of its own. {status} is the HTTP status code, like 502. Same for errors.uploadFailed, after sending a file.
